art_instructions: Wide, low-angle view of a small white-washed Greek village school, so the roof and sky dominate the upper half of the image. The building has blue wooden trim, a terracotta tile roof, a short porch with two wooden columns, and a stone path leading to a door over which hangs a small wooden plaque painted “ΣΧΟΛΗ.” On the left, include a compact olive tree; on the right, show a bit of a simple wooden playground and a stone birdbath near the entrance; bougainvillea climbs a trellis by the door. Glaux the Owl is arriving on top of the school: place her at the right side of the roof ridge, mid-landing with wings half-spread, talons just touching the orange tiles, body about one-sixth of the image height so she reads clearly. She has mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, a small green scarf tied at her neck, and a tiny satchel slung across her body; her expression is pleased and focused, head slightly turned toward the viewer. Bright, sunny light casts crisp shadows under the eaves and across the porch; the sky is clear Mediterranean blue. Add a couple of tiny local birds near the eaves and a butterfly over the bougainvillea to suggest gentle motion, but keep all attention on the owl landing on the roof.
